item.name: 🔗 Get Institution User V1

query.value: contactMethods($filter=(validated eq true) and (protocol eq 'VOICE')),postalAddresses($filter=state eq 'CA')

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Get Institution User V1 Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2a | \[Option 1\] Get Institution User V1 - INSTITUTION_USER_ID | Retrieves user profile using the institution-specific user ID. |
| 2b | \[Option 2\] Get Institution User V1 - HOST_USER_ID | Retrieves user profile using the host system member number. |
| 2c | \[Option 3\] Get Institution User V1 - LOGIN_ID | Retrieves user profile using the user’s login identifier. |
| 2d | \[Option 4\] Get Institution User V1 - LEGACY_USER_GUID | Retrieves user profile using the legacy customer GUID. |
| 2e | \[Option 5\] Get Institution User V1 - USER_ID | Retrieves user profile using the authentication user identifier. |
| 2f | \[Option 6\] Get Institution User V1 - contactMethods | Retrieves the user profile along with contact methods. |
| 2g | \[Option 7\] Get Institution User V1 - postalAddresses | Retrieves the user profile along with postal addresses. |
| 2h | \[Option 8\] Get Institution User V1 - subUsers | Retrieves the user profile along with sub-users. |
| 2i | \[Option 9\] Get Institution User V1 - Filters | Retrieves the user profile, with search filters applied only to the $expand query parameter. |
